provenance.reference: stabrank verify_challenge (extending cert_cat_m7_lift.py by Michel de Messieres)
provenance.method: projection monotonicity (<0|_1 |cat_m> = 2^{-1/2} |cat_{m-1}>) applied to 2-step exact Z[i] slice-and-lift c_5 -> c_6 -> c_7 on D_4

llm.role: we* multi-agent algebraic quotient and exact certificate synthesis

notes: chi(cat_10) >= ... >= chi(cat_7) >= 4: (<0|_1 (x) I)|cat_k> = 2^{-1/2}|cat_{k-1}> is verified symbolically for k = 5..10 before the claim is printed, and chi(cat_7) >= 4 is re-established from scratch in 3.7 s inside verify_challenge/cert_cat_m7_to_m10_lift.py by a compositional 2-step exact Z[i] slice-and-lift c_5 -> c_6 -> c_7 on D_4 (36,720 four-qubit stabilizer states, 100 pivot orbits under I_2 (x) G_4): because chi(c_5) = chi(c_6) = 3, every rank-3 decomposition of c_6 has all three terms non-zero on both slices along qubit 1 and is therefore obtained by lifting the unique rank-3 decomposition orbit of c_5 on D_4, which admits 1 exact lift to c_6 and 0 exact lifts to c_7. With bounds/cat-m10-upper-9.json this places the cell at 4 <= chi(cat_10) <= 9.
